title: Recover the owned preview worker
responsibility: Runs one Node worker, detects crashes, hangs and repeated server errors, and replaces it with bounded backoff at the same address.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.entry
inputs.description: Compiled Node launcher owned by this supervisor.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.args
inputs.description: Validated launch arguments passed unchanged to each replacement.

inputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.constructor.url
inputs.description: Stable loopback URL retained across worker replacements.

outputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.start
outputs.description: Ready worker address and an intentional shutdown operation.

outputs.name: PreviewWorkerService.close
outputs.description: Stops health checks and the owned child without respawning.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Refuses an unavailable or mismatched worker; ongoing recovery retries back off without starting overlapping workers.
examples: Preview worker did not become ready.
